visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short brown hair wearing a black and white striped sweater and dark pants sits cross-legged on a blue carpeted floor in a brightly lit, narrow hallway of a home or hotel. He looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression while gesturing slightly with his hands. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a prize board for the 'Fullmetal Alchemist' Ichiban Kuji lottery, showing various character figures (A, B, C, D) and stickers indicating prizes won. (3) The man, now wearing a black puffer vest over his striped sweater, stands in a brightly lit retail store filled with gashapon machines and toy displays. He points enthusiastically at a display case containing anime figures. (4) In the same store, the man performs an exaggerated 'luck dance' with wide arm movements while digital mathematical formulas and equations are overlaid across his image to suggest complex calculation. (5) A hand-to-hand exchange occurs where the man holds a lottery ticket against the glass display case; a clerk's hand is partially visible. Yellow electric-bolt graphics frame the interaction. (6) The scene returns to the hallway background. The man holds up four boxed mugs (E prizes) in front of his face, laughing with his mouth wide open. (7) He presents two flat-packaged towels (G prizes) to the camera, smiling broadly. (8) The man reveals the large Prize A figure box, his eyes widened and mouth open in a shout of triumph. He then hugs the box tightly to his chest. (9) He holds up the Prize C figure box, screaming with high arousal and excitement. (10) A final humorous scene shows the man sitting on a dark couch, completely covered in the prize boxes and a towel on his head like a statue. A woman in a green sweater and white beret enters, gasps in shock, and performs a series of dramatic bows and jumps in celebration of the haul.
